tagline: Make beautiful documents and carry precise feedback into the next draft

examples.prompt: Make a two-page orbital mechanics cheat sheet: Kepler's three laws, the vis-viva equation, a labelled diagram of an elliptical orbit, a Hohmann transfer from Earth to Mars worked out step by step, and a table of planet data. Two columns, dense but beautiful.
examples.caption: Orbital mechanics field guide · 2-page PDF, 3 figures, 3 tables

examples.prompt: Write a one-page spec sheet for a 20 mm M3 aluminium hex standoff: a title, a two-sentence description, a table of dimensions (length, across-flats, thread, mass), materials and finish, and a tolerances note. Keep it to one page.
examples.caption: Hex standoff spec sheet · 1-page PDF with drawing and dimension table

examples.prompt: Make a two-page design brief for a small desk lamp: the idea, intended use, dimensions, materials and three open questions. Use Typst and give it a clear visual hierarchy. I want to review the PDF in the pane before we revise it.
examples.caption: The reviewed PDF, anchored notes, readable feedback and a portable review ZIP.
